# Vitor Gabriel De Oliveira

Background spans full stack development (React, Node.js, PHP/Laravel, GraphQL, gRPC, REST), infrastructure (Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD), and AI Engineering (inference optimization, quantization, fine-tuning with LoRA/PEFT, model serving with vLLM).
